tcc_al1_binding.description: AL1 isoscalar vector doubly charmed tetraquark Tcc (ccqbarqbar, I(J^P)=0(1+)), Table I. Threshold D D* = 3878 MeV.

binding_mev.description: Variational energy minus the fixed lowest two-hadron threshold, in MeV, measured by the evaluator from fresh samples of the submitted wavefunction. More negative is stronger binding. 0 means no bound state; failed or unbound submissions get 0.

mc_error_mev.description: Monte Carlo standard error of that energy (evaluator's sampler, fixed sample count), in MeV, capped at 5.0. Failed or unbound submissions get the cap.

energy_mev.description: Total variational energy in MeV (diagnostic; ranked through binding_mev).

parameter_count.description: Stored constants of the submitted wavefunction in float64 equivalents (diagnostic; a budget of 10000 is enforced as a validity gate).

valid.description: 1 if the submission passed every evaluator gate, else 0 (diagnostic).

color_3bar3.description: Sampled antitriplet-triplet color-channel proportion (diagnostic, not an optimization target).

color_6bar6.description: Sampled sextet-antisextet color-channel proportion (diagnostic, not an optimization target).

tcc_al1_binding._note: Paper rows are the published numbers (deepquark: DeepQuark, gem: Gaussian expansion method). mc_error_mev 0.1 is the paper's stated upper bound; parameter_count 1857/2921 is the size of the authors' released default network, not a number printed in the paper. threshold_baseline is the evaluator's fixed no-binding row.
